title: Penthouse Magazine May 1993 Mike Tyson Dershowitz Gina Lamarca Vintage
descriptionText:
Penthouse magazine, May 1993 issue. Featured: "The Rape of Mike Tyson" by Alan M. Dershowitz, "American Gladiators": Behind-the-Scenes Special Report, "No Trumpet Needed: Roxanne Pulitzer's Basic Instincts," and "Baseball's Shame: Disrespecting Phil Rizzuto." Pet of the Month: Gina Lamarca.
Complete issue, no missing pages. Ships discreetly in a plain wrapper/sleeve.
Adult content — buyer must be 18+.
